name: Summit AZ - Decisions and Rules
body:
> Decision · Summit Az · 2026-10-22

# Summary
A synthesis of the standing decisions for Summit Plumbing Pros Arizona, pulled from CLAUDE.md, the Oct 1 session handoff, the Company Master Profile, the OTTO business rules and dated change-log entries through Oct 22, 2026. When in doubt, the binding text is in [Summit AZ - Project Guide (CLAUDE.md)](lib:brain-summit-az-project-guide-claude-md).

# Who decides
- Scott (owner side) approves homepage changes, business claims, services, hours, schema business details, forms, ads and money. Kim relays his answers.
- Kim approves all page-level SEO and content work. Drafts first, exact change shown, then apply.
- Quote Kim's authorizing instruction before any server-side write (agency-wide rule).

# SEO system
- Rank Math is the only implementation tool (Scott Sep 5, Kim Sep 9). Yoast inactive.
- Search Atlas / OTTO analysis only. OTTO pixel (snippet 23) and MetaSync stay OFF (Kim reconfirmed Sep 10, 15, 21). Never Deploy or Deploy All.
- Homepage (page 4752) locked; one-time exception Oct 8, and later Scott-approved work Oct 21 to 22 (map embed, Local SEO schema, footer social icons). Kim chose to keep the current homepage H1 (Oct 21).
- Never change slugs (Kim Sep 4). Focus keyword must appear in H1, SEO title, meta description and body (Kim Sep 15).
- Titles: full "| Summit Plumbing Pros" suffix or none; never "Summit Plumbing" alone in titles meant as the brand. On Oct 16 31 titles were shortened to 60 characters or less, most city pages dropping the suffix.

# Business claims
- 15 approved services; residential only (ROC #338366 R-37R). No commercial, roof drain, gas line, septic, sump pump, repiping promotion. Epoxy lining and pipe bursting unconfirmed, so removed from pages.
- Hours Mon to Sat 8 to 5, closed Sunday. No 24/7, after-hours, holiday or guaranteed same-day claims. "Same-day service for most calls" is the strongest wording.
- No prices; cost questions get a no-number answer and "Contact us for a free estimate".
- No guarantees, warranties, years of experience, certifications, "bonded", invented reviews or stories.
- Phones are GHL dynamic: default (480) 447-7008, GBP (480) 470-8706. Never flag NAP phone mismatches; keep phones out of metas. Schema now carries the GBP number (Oct 22).
- Never name or link competitors; cite neutral authorities only (.gov, utilities, EPA).

# Content rules
- Keyword research before drafting: Search Atlas volume 100+, KD 0 to 30, confirm with Kim. Check cannibalization against live Rank Math and GSC.
- City pages must be genuinely unique, built on sourced city or utility facts; no city-swap copy, no unconfirmed neighborhoods.
- Parent service pages use decision-stage FAQs with no city names; city pages keep local questions.
- /drain-cleaning/ is the design reference. Custom `[summit_lead_form]` is the form Scott wants.
- Blogs: author "Summit Plumbing Pros" (user 1), one at a time, no lead or comment form, FAQ last, AI images labeled illustrative, real job photos preferred.

# Accounts and data
- GBP location 93167 is hands off (read metrics only). Do not re-ask Scott about hours.
- GA4 Arizona 459518259; 529636373 is Utah. AZ data Sep 3 to 11 was misrouted to Utah.
- Use the GSC web UI for numbers, not the Search Atlas mirror (it undercounts).
- Never delete pages, posts, artifacts or WP Trash. Google Ads: no change without Kim's go.
